plan.title: [framework-gap] Codex hook root binding blocks linked-worktree reads and dependency bootstrap

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] Codex hook root binding blocks linked-worktree reads and dependency bootstrap
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Keep operator-callable one-path prep verb + shared guarded prep (foreign-worktree via mainWorktreeRoot; live foreign lease via occupancyAdmission===stranger and liveOccupancyOnTree; then PM; success = outer-visible PIN_REL exists)
- relieves: P1 — worktrees.ts and dest-place.ts create/reuse newly-installing paths call that guarded prep before success; lease/foreign refuse runs before reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit writes and before PM; regression zero PM and zero deposit mutation on stranger live lease
- relieves: P1 — ensureArcDest is in-contract: create path runs shared guarded prep after worktree add; reuse refuses stranger live occupancy before checkout; a deliberate process-only no-install mode is allowed only when the caller records verification-path pin-read and that mode is not the supported Codex consumer handoff
- relieves: P1 — Host-boundary + ordering unchanged: dest-rooted host session for matching launchRoot (6692738765); prep before re-root
- relieves: P2 — Unchanged: dedicated root-mismatch constant; shared INSTALLATION_RECOVERY_GUIDANCE untouched
- relieves: P3 — Unchanged: inspection under matching identity; maybeSelfCompleteSetup is setup; product mutations still gated
- relieves: P4 — Unchanged: packaged-consumer fixture with materialized .pnpm layout; injected launchingCheckoutRoot-only insufficient
- Footnote: CHANGELOG / docs; #5836 keep-out
narratives.UserStory: As a Codex/Grok leaf operator, I need linked-worktree dest prep that refuses stranger leases and installs under matching launchRoot so empty dest handoff works.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Stamp Prefer-A Recut-3 Bound 6693612913: shared guarded prep before deposit/PM; arc-dest in-contract; host re-root after prep; root-mismatch constant; packaged-consumer fixture.
